raw_html: [[Stormreaver's Thunderclap]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Stormreaver's Thunderclap]]:''' This item crackles with power, flickers of lightning emenating from it. On a Melee strike of a Natural 20 that is confirmed as a critical hit, this item will strike your foe with a tremendous burst of lightning. A DC 100 Reflex save will prevent half of this damage.
